description.value: Peaked Pies is a family-run Australian bakery cafe operating since 2013, specialising in handmade savoury and sweet meat pies at four BC locations including this Burnaby Heights outpost. The signature 'peaked' pie is served topped with mushy peas, mashed potatoes, and gravy — a format inspired by Australian street food tradition. The cafe also offers artisan coffee, breakfast pies, and housemade desserts, making it a solid stop for a hot, hearty meal on a ride through Burnaby.
